prompts.title: Christmas Captured in Glass
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality, 3D-rendered digital illustration in a Pixar/Disney-style animated aesthetic.
Use the uploaded person’s face strictly for exact face matching. Preserve the original facial identity, age, facial structure, skin texture, expression lines, and natural features without making the face younger or childlike.
⚠️ Important: Only the body proportions should resemble a child (8–10 years old). The face must remain the original real-world age of the uploaded person.

The character stands centered inside a magical Christmas snow globe, facing forward and looking directly at the viewer with a warm, friendly smile. The head and face retain realistic adult proportions, while the body height, limb length, and posture match that of an 8–10-year-old child in a stylized animated form.

The character wears a classic red Santa hat with a plush white brim and a fluffy white pom-pom.
Outfit includes a festive knit Christmas sweater with a Fair Isle pattern—horizontal red and green bands, white reindeer silhouettes, and detailed snowflake motifs—paired with dark green trousers and sturdy brown leather winter boots with laces.

Inside the snow globe, the character stands on pristine white snow. Behind them are three snow-dusted Christmas trees of varying heights, decorated with warm glowing yellow fairy lights. Several wrapped Christmas gifts lie near the feet, wrapped in red and green paper with gold and red ribbons. Fine white snow particles float in the air, giving the effect of a freshly shaken snow globe.

The entire scene is enclosed in a perfectly spherical transparent glass globe with subtle reflections and highlights from a soft front-top light source. The globe rests on a decorative circular base featuring a golden nameplate with “Tommy” written in elegant gold cursive lettering. The base is trimmed with a dark red or wooden rim and decorated with festive holly leaves and bright red berries on both sides.

Outside the globe, the background is heavily blurred with a bokeh effect, filled with warm golden, amber, and soft brown tones resembling distant Christmas lights, creating a cozy holiday atmosphere.

Soft cinematic lighting, rich textures, cute stylized body proportions, realistic face preservation, ultra-clean 3D animated film quality.
Aspect ratio: 4:5

prompts.prompt:

Face & Identity (Strict — Do Not Change)
Use the uploaded reference image strictly as the facial identity guide.

Copy the facial features exactly as shown — same face shape, proportions, eye size and spacing, nose structure, lips, smile, skin tone, and overall facial balance.

Do not beautify, stylize, or modify the face in any way.

Preserve natural skin texture, realistic pores, and soft, natural makeup exactly as seen in the reference.
Pose & Body Position
She is seated comfortably in a cross-legged position on the floor, facing directly toward the camera.

Her posture is relaxed and symmetrical.

Both hands gently hold a white ceramic mug close to her chest.

All limbs are fully visible and correctly proportioned.
Expression & Gaze
She looks directly at the camera with a warm, soft, natural smile.

Expression feels calm, friendly, and peaceful — not exaggerated or posed.
Outfit & Styling
She wears:

A classic red Santa hat with white fur trim and pom-pom
A cream-colored knitted sweater with visible ribbed texture and a cozy, slightly loose fit
Black fitted leggings
Festive knitted socks in red, green, and white patterns, fully visible

Her long, dark brown wavy hair falls naturally over her shoulders, softly reflecting the warm light.
Framing & Composition (Very Important)
Aspect ratio: 4:5 (vertical)

The subject remains centered in the frame.

Maintain slight negative space on the left side and upper area of the image.

These areas should appear cleaner, less detailed, and softly lit, suitable for text placement.

No objects should overlap or distract from the subject.
Background & Environment
Behind her is a classic indoor brick wall fireplace.

The wall is made of warm red-brown clay bricks, arranged in a traditional horizontal running-bond pattern with light beige mortar lines.

Brick texture is realistic and matte, slightly softened by depth of field — cozy and homely, not rough, industrial, or modern.

Inside the fireplace, soft glowing orange and yellow flames create a natural fire effect.

A decorated Christmas tree with warm white fairy lights is visible to the side, along with subtle wrapped gift boxes near the fireplace, kept minimal and non-distracting.
Lighting
Warm, golden lighting primarily comes from the fireplace.

Soft ambient indoor light fills the scene naturally.

Highlights are warm and golden, shadows are soft brown, never harsh black.

Lighting feels cinematic, cozy, and realistic — no artificial glow.
Color Tone & Image Grade
The overall image has a warm golden Christmas color tone.

Midtones lean toward cream, beige, and warm skin tones.

Slight orange and amber influence from the firelight.

Controlled saturation, medium-low contrast.

No cool blues, no green tint, no gray wash, no Instagram-style filters.

The look resembles a high-end Christmas movie still — premium, natural, and cozy.
Mood & Atmosphere
Quiet Christmas evening.

Festive, intimate, calm, warm, and peaceful.

Feels like a real candid holiday moment captured naturally.
Camera & Technical Quality
Ultra-realistic DSLR-style photography.

High resolution with sharp focus on the subject.

Shallow depth of field with gently softened background.

Balanced perspective with no lens distortion.
